theorem anonymous_target
  {a b C ε : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hε : 0 < ε) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
  (hRange : ∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b), f t ∈ Set.Icc 0 C) :
  ∃ g,
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < g t ∧ g t ≤ C + ε) ∧
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Icc a b, ‖g t - f t‖ < ε ∧ ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Icc a b, ‖√(2 * g t) - √(2 * f t)‖ ^ 2 < ε
